target_customer: Consumers who want help managing subscriptions, bills and shared expenses
problem: People lose track of subscriptions, bills, splits and budgets across accounts; Maxi texts them proactively over iMessage.
business_model: Consumer subscription (not confirmed by a source)

founders.name: Akeem Williams
founders.background_notes: Employers from the YC page bio. Education not listed. He is also listed as founder of the separate company Thread.

technical_complexity.rationale: Bank and Gmail aggregation plus an LLM agent over iMessage involves integrations and privacy handling but uses available APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregation and messaging layers are copyable, and no data or network moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows what incumbents did against Maxi.

market_need_then: Subscription clutter and budgeting are common consumer pains, but no dated evidence for Maxi's wedge was found.
